acceptanceCriteria: Either a native signal (or runner option) is identified that separates rejected statements from assertion failures and the adapter refuses/marks build errors, with a real runner witness and focused test; or the limitation is accepted in the spec as a documented non-qualified case with owner-accepted rationale.
The matrix legend makes the sqllogictest B cell meaning explicit.
body: Found by lane V1-1564 (PR beamfall/corvint#1017, head 0b30b1d36) on 2026-10-17. Retained witness /private/tmp/cem10-build/platform-2026-10-17/runs/sql-sqllogictest-sqlite/build-error/receipt.json: `SELECT FROM WHERE` runs as a failing query (runner exit 1, complete:true, one FAILED/UNKNOWN suite 'query failed', no problems). TRE-V0-009 build-error case is therefore not qualified for this profile; the native report has no field distinguishing an engine-rejected statement from an assertion mismatch. Retained as a release blocker in test-runner-execution-v0.md open residuals. The platform matrix cell for sqllogictest B column means 'witness retained', not 'refused'.
title: sqllogictest-sqlite: no build-error refusal; rejected statements look like assertion failures
